description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing God-Eternal Oketra.
When God-Eternal Oketra dies, it triggers, putting itself into your library third from the top.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to God-Eternal Oketra's power, ultimately milling God-Eternal Oketra.
Colossal Grave-Reaver's second ability triggers, putting God-Eternal Oketra from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
